title: stachys spinulosa var. glabrata
intro: Stachys spinulosa var. glabrata, commonly known as Smooth Betony or Woolly Betony, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety, improving sleep quality, and soothing digestive issues. The health benefits of Smooth Betony are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. The plant's bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to its calming and relaxing properties, making it a popular herbal remedy for stress relief and promoting overall well-being.
